title: Austin Policy Budget & Department Reviews
summary:
*   City officials convened a special Policy Budget Worksession to review departmental finances and future planning.
*   Numerous city departments, from Fire and EMS to Aviation and Environmental, presented their budget overviews and operational needs.
*   The session was dedicated to comprehensive discussions aimed at providing direction to the City Manager on upcoming budget policies.
*   The meeting experienced significant attendance issues after a recess, leading to a lack of quorum for several hours.
